items.title: Hantavirus outbreak on cruise ship not start of pandemic, UN health agency says
items.description: Ther World Health Organization says it is not in the same situation as with Covid-19 because hantavirus spreads differently.

items.title: Trump's 'irresponsible war' to blame for economic slowdown, German minister says
items.description: Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil blamed the US president's "irresponsible war in Iran" for harming the Germany economy.

items.title: Rosenberg: Russia's Victory Day parade with no tanks a sign Ukraine war not going to plan
items.description: For the first time in nearly two decades, there will be no military hardware, just soldiers during Saturday's parade in Moscow.

items.title: Trump gives EU ultimatum deadline to approve trade deal with US
items.description: Trump's deadline to the European Union came as a trade court ruled his global tariff policy violated US law.

items.title: Two Islamic-State linked Australian women charged with crimes against humanity
items.description: A third woman who also returned to Australia from Syria was charged with joining a terrorist organisation.

items.title: Fears of renewed Gaza war as Hamas disarmament talks stall
items.description: Israeli media reports suggest Israel is preparing to resume fighting because of the impasse in talks with Hamas.

items.title: Rwandan singer dies as he was being released from prison
items.description: The former university lecturer was a vocal critic of the government and ruling Rwandan Patriotic Front party.

items.title: Five killed in huge fire at packed Mexico fairground
items.description: The blaze in the south-eastern city of Villahermosa erupted during a concert reportedly attended by some 135,000 people.

items.title: US judge releases Jeffrey Epstein's purported suicide note
items.description: Epstein's former cellmate claims he found the note, which has not been verified by the BBC.

items.title: China announces suspended death sentences for former defence ministers
items.description: The announcement follows recent ousting of several top officials in China's military.

items.title: 'I wouldn't pay it' - Trump on USA ticket price
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he "wouldn't pay it either" when asked about the potential ticket price to watch his country play Paraguay in their 2026 World Cup opener.

items.title: Valverde cut head when he 'accidentally hit table' in Tchouameni row
items.description: Federico Valverde went to hospital after a dressing room row with Real Madrid team-mate Aurelien Tchouameni which left him with a head injury after he "accidentally hit a table".
